Know the basics

Every blood type has a place.

Blood groups are important details when coordinating a donation request. BloodConnect supports all eight common groups — and the rarest one of all.

A+
Type A PositiveBlood group
A−
Type A NegativeBlood group
B+
Type B PositiveBlood group
B−
Type B NegativeBlood group
O+
Type O PositiveBlood group
O−
Type O NegativeBlood group
AB+
Type AB PositiveBlood group
AB−
Type AB NegativeBlood group
Rhnull
✦ The rarest blood on Earth

Golden Blood (Rh-null)

Golden Blood lacks every antigen of the Rh system. Only a few dozen people in the world are known to have it, so each donor and each request is precious and often needs coordination across cities.

Extremely rare Lifesaving for rare Rh types Donors are treasured

Important: these cards are informational only. Blood compatibility and donor eligibility must be confirmed by qualified healthcare professionals. This page does not perform donor matching.

Why BloodConnect

Built for the moment it matters most

Hospitals and families lose critical time searching for a matching donor. BloodConnect keeps a verified, always-on network so that time gets spent saving lives, not making calls. We're available 24/7.

Verified donors

Everyone listed as a donor has signed up and confirmed their details — no anonymous listings.

Admin-reviewed requests

Every patient request is checked by our admin team before it's matched to donors, keeping the network reliable.

Always on

Requests can be submitted any time, day or night — the network never closes.

24/7 Helpline

Urgent help or a problem to report? Our care team is always on.
